= Compatibility regression fixtures

`roc-ray-step1.roc.txt` is copied unchanged from roc-ray's
`docs/tutorial/step1.roc` at commit `3b9b7dc0d0b3a5fbb36d15966caab41341d02b88`. The accompanying
integration test uses the `tag=body,indent=0` include form from
`docs/first-game.adoc`. It compares the displayed source with an independent
selection of the original checked-in example. Rendering does not compile or
execute examples; consumers retain their example checks.

`roc-ray-examples-table.adoc` retains the header and first row of the
same revision's `docs/examples.adoc` table, with a literal `src` attribute.
The first cell wraps onto a line containing the next cell separators.

`roc-parser-csv-guide.expected` is copied unchanged from roc-parser's
`docs/examples/csv-guide.expected` at commit
`c542066aae55f7c205853244a5aee912a5ed422e` (3.0.0).
`roc-parser-csv-outputs.adoc` retains that revision's seven output listing blocks
from `docs/csv.adoc`, including their original `lines=` directives, under a fixture
title. The integration test independently slices the checked output bytes and
compares HTML, Markdown and provenance digests. The fixture output remains inert;
roc-parser owns compiling and comparing its example's stdout.
